# {{version}} ({{date}})

## Install

Ubuntu / Debian:

```bash
sudo apt install ./litearm-vr-bundle_{{version}}_amd64.deb
```

Other glibc 2.35+ Linux (experimental):

```bash
sudo tar -C / -xzf litearm-vr-bundle_{{version}}_amd64.tar.gz
sudo /usr/lib/litearm-vr-bundle/portable-install.sh
```

The `.tar.gz` expects `python3`, `python3-venv`, `dkms`, `build-essential`, and matching kernel headers. Each artifact has a `.sha256` sidecar. See `MANIFEST.json` for the source commit and component pins.
